expected_games_note: User brief expected 1684 games / 3368 sides. Actual cohort is PBP ∩ MATCHED trades on disk.
pbp_timestamp_precision: RFC3339 UTC from StatsAPI play startTime (seconds typical; source digits preserved)
kalshi_timestamp_precision: RFC3339 created_time; fractional digits preserved in source string; not upgraded
notes: Cohort is PBP + MATCHED Kalshi TRADES. Historical L2/order-book is UNAVAILABLE; none invented.
AS-OF: latest W3 event with effective time <= market created_time.
Exact timestamp equality is AT_EVENT. Applicable state is W3 after-state; pre_event_state is also stored.
Observations after the last PBP event are AFTER_LAST_EVENT and do not snap to the last state.
next_event_time is diagnostic only and is not used to construct state.
Retrieval/ingest time is provenance only and never orders observations.
Unmatched Kalshi catalog rows remain in ingest identity artifacts; they are not this cohort.
